changes_only: where fresh grading evidence may be held
how private evidence is committed, audited, and admitted
scope.prospective_procedural_clarification: the outside-scope validator may strip JSON whitespace only, then requires one object whose first and last non-whitespace bytes are { and }; fences, prose, duplicate keys, and repaired carriers remain invalid, preserving the v1 packet one-object/no-fence/no-prose rule
scope.claim_limit: publicly commitment-verifiable and independently audited; not publicly reproducible while raw custody bytes remain private

activation.proposal_only_until: these exact amendment and specification-validator bytes reach the default branch by maintainer merge
activation.active_only_when: a conforming custody profile, activation receipt, attempt-preregistration/dispatch ledger, authenticated audit verifier, and full private-to-public derivation validator later reach the default branch
suspension_events: private evidence is unavailable to the designated verifier
an immutable locator or committed hash fails verification
retention, access logging, or independent audit ceases
the platform or evidence owner refuses sanctioned custody

versioning.adopted_bytes: the canonical Git blob of this amendment is immutable authority; companion custody/receipt schemas in this proposal are draft interfaces, not operational authority
versioning.downstream_binding: the later activation receipt must bind the exact adopted amendment blob plus the final merged operational schema, validator, authenticator, and tool blob hashes
versioning.change_rule: any byte change to this amendment requires a new amendment version and maintainer merge; draft operational schemas may change only before activation and become immutable when the activation receipt binds them

fresh_attempt.failure_rule: any refusal, malformed output, custody defect, or missing lane item makes the batch PARTIAL_UNPAIRED; preserve it and require separate authorization for a new full attempt

packet_transport.grader_visible_packet: reuse the ratified v1 packet format, content allowlist, and one-object/no-fence/no-prose GRADING_TASK; after activation, preregister one exact exporter-produced packet hash per item from one default-branch source commit and use that same item hash in both lanes; do not add this governance amendment to grader scope
packet_transport.outside_scope_binding: the preregistered attempt manifest and private bundle bind the unchanged packet hash to this amendment and custody profile
packet_transport.required_validation: invoke scripts/validate_arc_d_b2_packet.py over the complete packet directory and outside-scope export receipt before dispatch and again from private custody

requirements: sanctioned private storage with immutable content-addressed commit or object identity
separate lane write venues until all six bundles seal
append-only preservation of every dispatch outcome
named custodian and a distinct mechanical verifier with raw read access
the verifier is not the v1 rubric-author task, either grading instrument, or the coordinator
access log, retention rule, recovery copy, and export procedure
hash and size binding for every private artifact
signed-commit or OIDC-authenticated audit receipt binding validator source and result
public_receipts_must_exclude: response disposition before the batch seal
credentials, private paths, or access tokens

comparison_gate.opens_only_after: six public admission receipts and one batch receipt validate and reach the default branch atomically
comparison_gate.decision_rule: imported unchanged from the parent charter
comparison_gate.binding_event: a later maintainer merge of deterministic comparison receipts
comparison_gate.failure_default: PARTIAL_UNPAIRED or B2_REFERENCE_AMBIGUOUS; never favorable averaging or driver repair

required_later_merged_components: custody profile plus a separate default-branch activation receipt with canonical Git-blob proof
publicly preregistered six-cell attempt manifest and append-only dispatch/failure ledger
full exact-v1 packet-tree revalidation from private immutable Git objects
authenticated audit receipt and executable signature or OIDC verification
private-to-public derivation validator that reads exact private Git commit/tree/blob objects
public commitment-shape validator that can never report semantic admission
batch validator binding both lanes to the parent charter's exact per-item prompt/response hashes and identical packet hashes

historical_attempts.grade_b_attempts_1_through_3: preserved v1 history; no receipt may be grandfathered
historical_attempts.existing_claim_state: zero binding B2 dispositions, candidate residues, or HARVEST events

failure_default: missing, malformed, unavailable, mutable, contaminated, pre-activation, selectively reported, or unaudited evidence remains PARTIAL_UNPAIRED and cannot enter comparison, B3, B4, or HARVEST
